newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR FRANCE V ITALY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR FRANCE V ITALY.

text.p: Teams for the closing match of the Tournoi de France between France and Italy on Wednesday:

France - 1-Lionel Charbonnier; 15-Lilian Thuram, 4-Franck Leboeuf, 8-Marcel Desailly, 12-Bixente Lizarazu; 13-Ibrahim Ba, 19-Christian Karembeu, 7-Didier Deschamps, 10-Zinedine Zidane; 22-Florian Maurice, 9-Christophe Dugarry.

Italy - 12-Gianluca Pagliuca; 23-Attilio Lombardo, 14-Alessandro Nesta, 6-Alessandro Costacurta, 5-Fabio Cannavaro, 3-Paolo Maldini; 7-Angelo Di Livio, 11-Gianfranco Zola, 8-Roberto Di Matteo; 9-Pierluigi Casiraghi, 20-Alessandro Del Piero.
